description: Per-flow background flags and split membership of the flagged sample (flagged_loader.py), keyed by source CSV and record number

columns.csv: source CSV, relative to data/CIC IoT-DIAD 2024/ (forward slashes)
columns.row: 0-based record number in that CSV (row 0 = first line after the header; pandas.read_csv numbering)
columns.idx: row position in results_2026_03_03/split_pilot/flagged_data.parquet = global row position used by the experiments
columns.y: class index: 0 Benign, 1 BruteForce, 2 DDOS, 3 DOS, 4 Mirai, 5 Recon, 6 Spoofing, 7 Web-Based
columns.sub: capture group (sub-folder, or the class when it has none)
columns.r1_external: R1: an endpoint outside 192.168.137.0/24 and 205.174.165.0/24 (attack classes only)
columns.r2_service: R2: service port 53, 67, 68, 123, 137, 138, 1900 or 5353 (DNS kept in DNS Spoofing)
columns.r3_benign_pair: R3: the unordered IP pair also occurs in the Benign captures
columns.split_random: stratified random 70/15/15 (seed 42) on all rows: train | val | test
columns.split_temporal: 70/15/15 by time inside each of the 16 capture groups, on all rows
columns.split_random_r1: split_random drawn on the rows not flagged by R1; excluded = R1-flagged
columns.split_temporal_r1: split_temporal on the rows not flagged by R1; excluded = R1-flagged
